body:
The escalation gate blocked approval of named rules, builds and plans when an interview included internal job context. Recognize direct consent per question while retaining the classifier for approach choices, decision loops and command handoffs.

Preserve legitimate onboarding noun approvals while excluding explicit leading method verbs. The latest repair adds insert/inserting to the existing name grammar, so an insertion implementation question cannot acquire consent merely by ending in plan. Quoted artifact names and scope qualifiers use the same grammar.

Validation:

- Four new real-hook fixtures for inserting, insert, quoted insertion and insertion in a scope qualifier failed before this repair and pass after it. Escalation selftest passes 79/79, including the earlier onboarding, quoted-name, scope and implementation fixtures.
- Gate-edit selftest passes 76/76. Strict gate integrity passes with only the escalation hook hash re-blessed. Whitespace passes.
- Merged origin/main with ordinary merge commit d3e10f3d. Required design and debt passes keep one pure consent predicate at the existing per-question interface, with no added wrapper or duplicated classifier.
- Full local ops/ci.sh --strict completed in the foreground. Pushfloor, unit, types, secret, dependency, binding, artifact and freshness passed; replay passed all 7,384 invocations. The gate class failed on local-review-evidence-selftest.py because the supplied PR-body setting was inherited into a fixture expecting none. Migration was skipped for absent CARR_CI_DATABASE_URL; contract grant coverage is partial for absent DATABASE_URL. The full run is not claimed green. Result: /tmp/pr1544-local-checks.json; log: /tmp/pr1544-local-checks.log.
- Standalone local-review-evidence-selftest.py passes 26/26 without the inherited PR-body setting, confirming the full-run failure depends on that invocation setting.
- check-eval-receipt passes with the existing context-hooks exemption below. This is an exemption, not an LLM eval result.

no-eval: context-hooks: Production transcripts are outside this repair's authorized synthetic-only scope, and no sealed human-judged corpus is supplied for this flow. The required LLM measurement cannot be constructed without reading unauthorized material or inventing source provenance. Deterministic behavior is verified through synthetic real-hook fixtures.

Open for orchestrator review. Do not merge. The orchestrator wrapper owns the push after this worker exits; hosted CI for the new commit remains unverified until then.
